channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
item.description: Ai2's HiRO-ACEv2 generates global 3 km climate data at about 1/300th the cost of X-SHiELD, with HiROv2 reproducing extremely rare rain, wind, and pressure events and matching them statistically to within 3%. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
item.description: HydraFusion has an updated model pool, improved orchestration workflows, and introduces HydraFusion Max. Both HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max are available across VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, and GitHub Copilot CLI and remain in research preview. HydraFusion orchestrates multiple (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
item.description: Amp says OpenAI models account for most of its tokens, with one user burning 10 billion tokens a week, as GPT-6 Astra lets agents produce documents and design pages and Puck enables real-time conversation. (OpenAI News)

item.title: GPT-5.5 retirement in Codex
item.description: GPT-5.5 retires from Codex on October 14, 2026 at noon PDT (19:00 UTC) for ChatGPT-signed-in users, who must move to GPT-6.1 Sol and update saved model settings, while API and API-key sessions remain unaffected. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
item.description: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore fine-tuned lightweight on-device Gemma models to flag impersonation scams in private chats in real time, with no data leaving the device; such fraud is over half of reported crimes there, costing S$4 billion since 2019. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
item.description: SentinelOne used OpenAI Daybreak to cut malware reverse engineering from 4–6 weeks to roughly 8 hours, freeing security researchers to analyze more samples and surface cross-sample links. (OpenAI News)

item.title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
item.description: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James and 40 bipartisan state attorneys general filed a notice in Character.AI's Chapter 11 bankruptcy demanding user data protections before any asset sale to Disney, covering the private chats that could change hands.

item.title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
item.description: Google Research's Deep Review, trialed on 16,000+ submissions to STOC, ICML, NeurIPS and ICLR, now reviews complex documents beyond computer science papers—including legal, finance, Google Docs and presentations—to ease AI-generated content's verification bottleneck.

item.title: GPT-5.6 helped break Chrome’s defenses for a $250,000 Google bounty.
item.description: Xbow's Brendan Dolan-Gavitt spent six days and about $40,000 in compute running OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol against Chrome's source, chaining three independent bugs so ordinary JavaScript crossed two defense boundaries and escaped every sandbox, chasing Google's $250,000 bounty.

item.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
item.description: Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents concurrently for 36–48 hours of autonomous research, while Codex and GPT-5.6 cut a year of order-level US stock backtesting from about 3 hours to 3–5 minutes, a 97% reduction. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Results based on +5K real-world agentic sessions are in: Muse Wonder (Max) by @AIatMeta just landed in the Agent Arena at #12 with +6.4% ...
item.description: Based on over 5,000 real-world agentic sessions, Meta's Muse Wonder (Max) placed 12th in the Agent Arena with a +6.4% net gain, 2.8 points and four spots ahead of Muse Spark 1.3 (Max).

item.title: AI Daily: Doubao Work now supports importing ChatGPT conversation history; mainland China iPhones add new AI filing requirement; Qwen Office E-commerce Edition launches.
item.description: AI Daily: Doubao Work now supports importing ChatGPT conversation history; mainland China iPhones add new AI filing requirement; Qwen Office E-commerce Edition launches. (AIbase)

item.title: SpaceXAI’s Grok Voice 3.0 is the new leading Speech to Speech model, debuting at #1 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index at ...
item.description: SpaceXAI's Grok Voice 3.0 debuts at #1 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index with 86.9 points, beating GPT-Live-1 (Astra, medium) at 83.2 and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (High) at 82.6, a 5.6-point gain over Grok Voice 2.0.

item.title: From building your app to growing it: Lovable now helps you find customers
item.description: Lovable's new growth tools generate executable plans from app context in its existing chat and execute across Google Search, YouTube, Google Maps, Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram, as one-third of 400+ builders reportedly didn't know where to find customers. (Lovable Blog)

item.title: 实测Gemini 4 Argon：知识工作强劲但体验糟糕，卡兹克称难撼Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon became fully available on October 13. Pro members can use it in the Gemini app, while Antigravity requires the $100 Ultra membership. In the author's hands-on testing, it was strong at knowledge-heavy professional tasks, ranked first overall on Vals Index (68.9) at only $15.68 per run, but placed second-to-last on CUA-bench at just 4.83%. Its front-end results trail GPT-6 Astra, it burns through quota quickly, and its Chinese writing has a strong AI flavor. The overall experience is poor, and subscribing to Ultra is not recommended.

item.title: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
item.description: GitHub shipped GitHub Apps improvements adding two fine-grained permissions, including repository_creation:write, so developers can move off classic PATs, create repositories with less privilege, and let repository admins attach repos to org-approved apps. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon is now fully rolled out, but after hands-on testing the author doubts it can unseat Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Argon opened to all on October 14, but an author who paid $100 for Ultra access found it unable to unseat Claude Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 Astra, tracing Google's model delays and August 5 leadership shake-up.

item.title: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
item.description: MIT researchers' Nature paper describes a machine-learning post-processing layer that doubles two-to-six-week forecast accuracy by correcting existing models, winning ECMWF's subseasonal competition and improving flood and cold-wave warnings, potentially aiding 2021 Texas, where at least 246 died.

item.title: Context Engineering with Deep Agents: How To Remember Without Keeping Everything In Context
item.description: LangChain's open-source Deep Agents uses middleware such as FilesystemMiddleware to manage context windows and ease context rot; its example competitive-analysis agent, tracking five competitors weekly, carries five raw exports, dozens of search results and two stale drafts by step 4.
